_note: document-annotations task 1 (REQ-ANN-001): an annotation on a document is an OpenRegister object bound to the document version it was made on. Visibility (private, faction, body) cannot be expressed as a read rule, because the faction and body groups depend on each object; so the read rule here admits only administrators and the author, and the decidiq annotation endpoints (task 2) serve shared annotations behind their own check. The block declares no writes: a schema block denies what it omits to everyone but the owner and a superuser, so no member can write an annotation, or forge its author, around the endpoints that write it.
